<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022024-11-08-14-27" status="finalized">
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">gnyal pa</rs> na re sgra mi rtag byas na chos can brjod pa dang khyad par gzhan mi <lb n="28b4"/> spong pa'i sgra yin te | rang gi brjod bya mi rtag pa dang chos du ma'i rten sgra gnyis tha dad du brjod pa'i phyir ro || 
         sgra'i mi rtag byas na cig shos te | de dang de tha dad du brjod pa'i phyir ro || tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad yed 'dra'o || 
         de bzhin du gzugs sogs 'du 'god med zhes dang | gzugs <lb n="28b5"/> sogs kyi 'du 'god med ces pa'ang rim bzhin te tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med zer ro || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_089_02 legs spyad nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha'i rgyal po.xml
